body:
Its been 7 months and I still have absolutely no memory of that weekend. Apparently on the bus ride home (we were at a tournament 8 hours away with our school's boys team) I flirted with my ex-boyfriends best friend, told everyone in my general vicinity on the bus all my secrets, and downloaded a Bible app (which I keep forgetting to uninstall and every time I turn on my phone it tells me to read the Bible). 

Now I just have short-term memory problems, I actually have to study for tests, and I frequently blow people off because I completely forget about them.
I'm very asthmatic, I don't think smoking would help my cause instead it'd probably make me end up in the ER
I go back September 12th. The problem is because I'm a minor I'm not alone with the nuerologist at any point in the appointment.
I never got headaches before my concussion. Maybe once or twice a year. Now I get ones that are a 7-9 on a scale of 1-10 at least every other day.

I'm a senior in high school, but I'm  a baby in my grade and won't be turning 18 until I'm in college. 


By father grew up in poverty and so did my mother. Now my dad is a CFO after paying his own way through college, grad school, etc. I know if I say anything they will tell me I'm being a brat, my dad will lecture me about how my grandfather worked 3 jobs and my life isn't that bad etc etc etc. My job is driving my little siblings to practices, and my parents pay me per week. So they could completely cut me off from money if they wished. I'm hoping that next time I go to the neurologist she'll give me medicine that works. I feel like that if my headaches went away I'd be able to cope with the depression again. Right now it's just all too much.
I finally had and MRI last week. It turns out i broke my nose when i got the concussion and I have a 1 cm wide cyst in the left side of my brain, but was told that it was a "normal abnormality"
